name: Real Anthropomorphic Animal People
description: Makes super realistic anthropomorphic creatures, Strength .6-1, start around .7 or .8. Various prompts about animal people hybrids work, but for ease: anthropomorphic {type of animal} {subject} i.e. anthropomorphic goat man, anthropomorphic walrus woman, etc. Works with Dev, Krea, and the couple other finetunes I tried. Incidentally, I trained it as hybrid , not anthropomorphic , yet anthropomorphic works better.
